# Forced sample composition: host source results

This checkpoint links actual owned ordinary/slow acquisition to retained ACK
arguments for the concrete admitted-range memory diagnostic. No SDK/VM call,
resource reset, live sampling, native proof or product acceptance is claimed.
The earlier max=6325 outcome stays unaccepted.

Author and all three independent source reviewers ran **104 passing host tests**.
CODE and Python reviewers also checked distinct raw stat-read custody; CODE
checked a changed final census and Python checked a falsey original exception.
Security independently rejected ten additional malformed records. Sources remain
within 800 lines and functions within 50. Host runtime is Python3.15; guest3.12
execution and optional third-party linters were not run or installed.

The [lossless inert history](sample-history.jsonl.gz) preserves the recommendation,
parent adoption, RED/GREEN records, original failures, debugger investigations,
coverage and independent source reviews. Each UTF-8 record includes its original
byte count and SHA-256. Intermediate source hashes and failure diagnostics do not
supply every intermediate source version. Do not execute archived snippets.

Four exact borrowed-owner counterexamples failed before repair: stream and sync
replacement both between calls and during synchronization. Strong references and
identity checks now block ACK return and avoid gap writes to changed owners.
Partial ordinary/slow writes, either sync failure, and compound primary/gap
failures pass their final tests. Temporary filesystem fixtures close descriptors
and remove themselves; unique result evidence is retained.

Six separately planted in-memory defects were rejected: omitted slow row,
discarded unknown event, waived historical nonzero, omitted final identity,
omitted owner guard, and swallowed compound gap failure. Five were assertion
rejections. The sixth raised the original errno5 OSError instead of the expected
BaseExceptionGroup; independent Phase1 reproduced this behavioral rejection3/3.
The original strict failures-only wrapper consequently failed and is preserved.
This classification does not count arbitrary unittest errors as mutation kills.
Original disk source was unchanged and the restored104 tests passed.

The first coverage report assembly failed because Python3.15's stdlib trace
included None/zero sentinels. After independent Phase1, a fresh104-test traced run
excluded only those verified sentinels and retained all positive executable lines.
Modules were imported under tracing. Actual line coverage is observe.py565/587
(96.25%) and boundary.py426/454 (93.83%). Branch coverage is NOT_MEASURED. This
metric includes imports/declarations and is not comparable without qualification
to the prior checkpoint's pre-imported tracing. It proves neither race coverage
nor runtime/continuous-memory cost.

The source uses trusted borrowed roots and callbacks; object identity is not
filesystem immutability or power-loss durability. Parent/root linkage, live
preflight, periodic scheduling, channel publication, invocation, overhead and
fresh epoch review remain required. The source and results grant no automatic
retry, counter waiver, production binding or Pages acceptance.
